mapper.select: SELECT c.CHECKLIST_ID, c.ITEM_ID, c.TITLE, c.IS_COMPLETED, c.COMPLETED_AT, c.COMPLETED_BY, c.SORT_ORDER, c.DUE_DATE, c.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, c.CREATED_AT, c.CREATED_BY, c.UPDATED_AT, c.UPDATED_BY, a.NAME AS ASSIGNEE_NAME, cb.NAME AS COMPLETED_BY_NAME, i.CONTENT AS ITEM_TITLE FROM TB_ITEM_CHECKLIST c INNER JOIN TB_ITEM i ON c.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER a ON c.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = a.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER cb ON c.COMPLETED_BY = cb.USERNAME WHERE c.CHECKLIST_ID = #{checklistId}

SELECT c.CHECKLIST_ID, c.ITEM_ID, c.TITLE, c.IS_COMPLETED, c.COMPLETED_AT, c.COMPLETED_BY, c.SORT_ORDER, c.DUE_DATE, c.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, c.CREATED_AT, c.CREATED_BY, c.UPDATED_AT, c.UPDATED_BY, a.NAME AS ASSIGNEE_NAME, cb.NAME AS COMPLETED_BY_NAME FROM TB_ITEM_CHECKLIST c LEFT JOIN TB_USER a ON c.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = a.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_USER cb ON c.COMPLETED_BY = cb.USERNAME WHERE c.ITEM_ID = #{itemId} ORDER BY c.SORT_ORDER ASC, c.CREATED_AT ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITEM_CHECKLIST WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND IS_COMPLETED = TRUE

SELECT c.CHECKLIST_ID, c.ITEM_ID, c.TITLE, c.IS_COMPLETED, c.COMPLETED_AT, c.SORT_ORDER, c.DUE_DATE, c.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, c.CREATED_AT, i.CONTENT AS ITEM_TITLE FROM TB_ITEM_CHECKLIST c INNER JOIN TB_ITEM i ON c.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID WHERE c.ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = #{assigneeUsername} AND c.IS_COMPLETED = FALSE AND i.STATUS NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELETED') ORDER BY c.DUE_DATE ASC, c.SORT_ORDER ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITEM_CHECKLIST ( ITEM_ID, TITLE, IS_COMPLETED, SORT_ORDER, DUE_DATE, ASSIGNEE_USERNAME, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{title}, #{isCompleted}, #{sortOrder}, #{dueDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{assigneeUsername, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_ITEM_CHECKLIST SET TITLE = #{title}, IS_COMPLETED = #{isCompleted},
COMPLETED_AT = NOW(), COMPLETED_BY = #{updatedBy},
COMPLETED_AT = NULL, COMPLETED_BY = NULL,
SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, DUE_DATE = #{dueDate, jdbcType=DATE}, ASSIGNEE_USERNAME = #{assigneeUsername, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = NOW(), UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE CHECKLIST_ID = #{checklistId}

UPDATE TB_ITEM_CHECKLIST SET IS_COMPLETED = #{isCompleted},
COMPLETED_AT = NOW(), COMPLETED_BY = #{completedBy},
COMPLETED_AT = NULL, COMPLETED_BY = NULL,
UPDATED_AT = NOW(), UPDATED_BY = #{completedBy} WHERE CHECKLIST_ID = #{checklistId}
